title: A Master Protocol of Multiple Agents in Adults With Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (SYNERGY-Outcomes)
official: N1T-MC-MALO:  A Master Protocol for a Randomized, Controlled, Clinical Trial of Multiple Pharmacologic Agents in Adult Participants With Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease Who Are at Increased Risk of Developing Major Adverse Liver Outcomes (SYNERGY-Outcomes); N1T-MC-TZ01 Tirzepatide in participants with high-risk MASLD; N1T-MC-RT01 Retatrutide in participants with high-risk MASLD
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate whether the primary intervention is superior to the primary control in reducing the occurrence of MALO.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have hepatic steatosis (liver fat), diagnosed with MRI
2. Have liver fibrosis, diagnosed with non-invasive tests
3. (Liver biopsy not needed for enrollment in this trial)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have any other type of liver disease other than MASLD
2. Have a body mass index (BMI) <25 kilogram per square meter (kg/m2)
3. Prior cirrhotic liver disease (history of esophageal / gastric varices, ascites, hepatic encephalopathy, historical diagnosis of cirrhosis on liver biopsy)
4. Have lost more than 11 pounds within the 3 months prior to screening
5. Have a hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) greater than 10%
6. Have type 1 diabetes
